title: Density Functional Theory (DFT) Calculation Package — Overview and definition
t: Density Functional Theory (DFT) Calculation Package — Overview and definition
description: Computes electronic structure, energies, and forces from quantum mechanics.
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Computes electronic structure, energies, and forces from quantum mechanics. A DFT package solves the Kohn-Sham equations with plane-wave or localized basis sets and pseudopotentials to predict formation energies, band structures, and forces. Real implementations include VASP, Quantum ESPRESSO, GPAW, and ABINIT. It converges k-points, cutoffs, and SCF cycles, and supports Hubbard-U, hybrid, and van der Waals corrections.
capabilities: Band structures and densities of states
Phonon spectra via DFPT or finite differences
